name: MonarchMediaUpload
title: MediaUpload
wrapsNative: MonarchFileUpload with androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia, android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever for video length, MonarchProgress (androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator), androidx.compose.foundation.Image for the preview, MonarchButton and MonarchInlineNotice
summary: A field that holds one image or video: pick it with the system photo picker, see it checked and uploaded with progress, then preview it with Replace and Remove.
whenToUse: For one picture or clip that belongs to a record: a cover image, a product photo, an intro video.
whenNotToUse: For a profile picture with cropping use MonarchAvatarUpload. For several files or documents use MonarchFileUpload with MonarchUploadQueue.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMediaUpload(label: String, value: String?, onValueChange: (String?) -> Unit, onUpload: suspend (MonarchPickedFile, MonarchMediaUploadContext) -> MonarchMediaUploadResult, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, kind: MonarchMediaUploadKind? = null, preview: Painter? = null, helperText: String? = null, kinds: Set<MonarchMediaUploadKind> = setOf(MonarchMediaUploadKind.Image), maxImageSize: Long? = null, maxVideoSize: Long? = null, maxVideoDurationMillis: Long? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, videoUnavailable: String? = null, previewLabel: String? = null, onPlay: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchMediaUploadLabels = MonarchMediaUploadLabels())
class MonarchMediaUploadResult(url: String, warnings: List<String> = emptyList())
class MonarchMediaUploadContext(kind: MonarchMediaUploadKind, progress: (Float) -> Unit) { fun reportProgress(fraction: Float) }

class MonarchMediaUploadLabels(addImage: String? = null, addMedia: String? = null, chooseImage: String? = null, chooseMedia: String? = null, imageHint: ((maxSize: String?) -> String)? = null, videoHint: ((maxSize: String?, maxDuration: String?) -> String)? = null, videoNotAllowed: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, tooLarge: ((name: String, maxSize: String) -> String)? = null, tooLong: ((name: String, maxDuration: String) -> String)? = null, durationUnreadable: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, checking: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, uploading: ((name: String, percent: Int?) -> String)? = null, uploadFailed: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, cancelled: String? = null, imageUploaded: String? = null, videoUploaded: String? = null, replaceImage: String? = null, replaceVideo: String? = null, removeImage: String? = null, removeVideo: String? = null, imageRemoved: String? = null, videoRemoved: String? = null, previewVideo: String? = null, play: String? = null, warnings: String? = null, formatDuration: ((millis: Long) -> String)? = null, fileUpload: MonarchFileUploadLabels = MonarchFileUploadLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It is a heading.

options.name: value
options.description: The address of the stored file, or null when empty.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new address after an upload, and with null after Remove.

options.name: onUpload
options.description: Stores the file, reports progress through the context and returns the stored address and any warnings. Cancel upload cancels its coroutine. Throw to show the error.

options.name: kind
options.description: The kind of the current file. When null, the kind of the latest upload, or a guess from the address's extension.

options.name: preview
options.description: The stored image or the video's poster, loaded by the app. A tinted tile while null.

options.name: kinds
options.description: The kinds that are taken; the photo picker offers only these.

options.name: maxImageSize
options.description: The largest image, in bytes. Larger images are refused with the file name and the limit.

options.name: maxVideoDurationMillis
options.description: The longest video, in milliseconds, read from the file's metadata before upload. A video whose length cannot be read is refused.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false the picker, Replace and Remove do nothing and take the disabled colors.

options.name: videoUnavailable
options.description: Why videos cannot be added, in the product's words. Shown in the hint when kinds has no video, and videos can then be picked so the refusal explains itself.

options.name: previewLabel
options.description: The spoken name of the image preview. "Uploaded image" when null.

options.name: onPlay
options.description: Plays the video, for example in the system player. Makes the video preview a "Play video" button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, and the file picker area's strings including formatSize.

states.name: empty
states.description: The MonarchFileUpload zone with "Add an image" (or "Add an image or video"), the hint lines and the Choose button.

states.name: checking
states.description: An indeterminate progress bar with "Checking clip.mp4…" and Cancel upload while a video's length is read.

states.name: uploading
states.description: A progress bar, indeterminate until the first report, with "Uploading photo.png · 40%" and Cancel upload.

states.name: filled
states.description: The preview at 16:9, then Replace (a compact picker) and Remove.

states.name: refused
states.description: The picker's danger notice names the file and the reason: a video where only images are taken, or too large. Too long and unreadable videos are shown as a danger notice under the field.

states.name: failed
states.description: A danger notice with the error's message, or "The upload failed. Try again."; the value is unchanged.

states.name: warnings
states.description: A warning notice titled "Uploaded with warnings." with one line per warning.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The picker and buttons do nothing and take the disabled colors.

appearance: The empty zone and the Replace button are MonarchFileUpload's; the label uses the default text role, help and status text the muted role, the preview placeholder the muted background role, the progress bar the accent solid role, and notices the danger and warning tone roles. All come from MonarchTheme in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web has a drop zone and a hidden file input. On Android the path is the system photo picker (PickVisualMedia), which needs no storage permission and also reaches cloud photos on recent versions; iOS offers Photos and Files buttons, Android offers the one photo picker. Dragging files onto the field is not offered (see drop-zone). The web's transform callback is not offered: an app shrinks or converts the file inside onUpload. Cancellation is coroutine cancellation instead of an AbortSignal, progress is a fraction from 0 to 1 instead of a percentage, and the length limit is in milliseconds. The value is the stored file's address; Monarch loads no images, so the app passes the stored image or poster as preview, and plays a video through onPlay instead of iOS's built-in player. Same name as iOS.
accessibility: The label is a heading and the help text follows it.
Choose, Cancel upload, Replace and Remove are buttons with 48dp touch targets.
The progress bar's spoken name is the status text, with the percentage when known.
Refusals and failures are shown with text in a danger notice, not by color alone, and announced through a polite live region.
"Image uploaded", "Video uploaded", "Upload cancelled" and "Image removed" are announced through a polite live region.
The image preview is one image named "Uploaded image" or previewLabel; a video preview with onPlay is a "Play video" button.
edgeCases: A file whose provider reports no size passes the size limit; the app can check the bytes in onUpload.
The kind is read from the MIME type, then from the extension; a stored address without an extension is taken as an image unless kind is passed.
Cancelling during the length check stops before onUpload is called.
Remove only clears the value; deleting the stored file is the app's job in onValueChange.
Reported fractions outside 0 to 1 are clamped.

examples.title: Image with a size limit, videos unavailable
examples.webExample: Image with a size limit, videos unavailable
examples.template:
MonarchMediaUpload(
    label = {{label}},
    value = cover,
    onValueChange = { cover = it },
    onUpload = { file: MonarchPickedFile, context ->
        // The app streams file.uri to its storage here and reports progress.
        context.reportProgress(1f)
        MonarchMediaUploadResult(url = "https://cdn.example.com/" + file.name)
    },
    helperText = {{description}},
    labels = MonarchMediaUploadLabels(addImage = "Drop an image here"),
    maxImageSize = {{maxImageSize}},
    videoUnavailable = {{videoUnavailable}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchMediaUpload(
    label = "Cover image",
    value = cover,
    onValueChange = { cover = it },
    onUpload = { file: MonarchPickedFile, context ->
        // The app streams file.uri to its storage here and reports progress.
        context.reportProgress(1f)
        MonarchMediaUploadResult(url = "https://cdn.example.com/" + file.name)
    },
    helperText = "Shown at the top of the page.",
    labels = MonarchMediaUploadLabels(addImage = "Drop an image here"),
    maxImageSize = 10_485_760,
    videoUnavailable = "Videos can’t be added to this item.",
)

examples.title: An image or a short video
examples.code:
MonarchMediaUpload(
    label = "Hero media",
    value = hero,
    onValueChange = { hero = it },
    onUpload = { file, _ -> MonarchMediaUploadResult(url = file.uri.toString()) },
    kinds = setOf(MonarchMediaUploadKind.Image, MonarchMediaUploadKind.Video),
    maxVideoDurationMillis = 90_000L,
    onPlay = { /* The app opens the video in a player. */ },
)

parityExceptions.reason: A phone has no drag and drop, so the drop target line is not drawn; the Choose image button and the size limit are.
parityExceptions.convention: touch: choose from the system picker, no drop zone
